find_nearest_postcodes.description: List the postcodes around another postcode, nearest first, each with how far away it is in metres, kilometres and miles. The postcode itself comes back first at zero. Use it to find neighbouring delivery areas, to widen a catchment, or to check what else is on a street. The default radius is 100 metres, which is a street rather than a neighbourhood, so raise it for a rural address. No API key required.

lookup_postcode.description: Look up everything Postcodes.io holds for one UK postcode: its coordinates, its country, region, local authority district, ward, parish and parliamentary constituency, its NHS and statistical areas, and the GSS code for each. Comes with a plain-English reading of how accurate the coordinates are and a map link. No API key required.

lookup_postcodes_bulk.description: Look up many UK postcodes in one step, which is what to use instead of a loop: a column from a spreadsheet, a list of customer addresses, a delivery run. The answers come back in the order they were sent, so they line up with the column they came from, and the ones that could not be matched are listed separately rather than left as gaps to sift out. Postcodes.io takes 100 per request and refuses a longer list outright, so this step splits a longer one into batches automatically, up to 1,000. Trim the fields to keep a large answer small. No API key required.

validate_postcode.description: Check whether a string is a live UK postcode. This is a real existence check against the Office for National Statistics postcode directory, not a format check: 'ZZ99 9ZZ' is correctly shaped and is not a postcode, and this says so. When the answer is no, the step also says whether the postcode used to exist and when it was withdrawn, so an address form can tell a customer 'that postcode was retired in 2018' rather than just rejecting it. Ideal in a condition before the rest of a workflow runs. No API key required.

description: Look up UK postcodes and geocode from a workflow, with no account and no API key. Get everything the Office for National Statistics holds for a postcode - coordinates, country, region, local authority district, ward, parish, parliamentary constituency, NHS and statistical areas, and the GSS code for each. Validate a postcode against the real directory rather than a regular expression, and find out when a retired one was withdrawn. Turn coordinates into postcodes and postcodes into coordinates, search or autocomplete a partial postcode, and list what is nearby. Look up hundreds of postcodes or coordinate pairs in one step. Measure the distance between two postcodes. Read an outward code as a whole postal area, search Ordnance Survey's gazetteer of British places, and get the Scottish-only geographies - council area, Data Zone, SIMD - that the UK-wide directory does not carry. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything.
